==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])

:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Cowing Staff]].
